body:
CMIP timing tests on ClimaCoupler (running on T4 devices) showed the following error (from @daverumph) : 
```
ERROR: Out of GPU memory trying to allocate 23.625 MiB
Effective GPU memory usage: 99.92% (14.552 GiB/14.563 GiB)
Memory pool usage: 13.712 GiB (13.906 GiB reserved)
...
...
[14] copy(bc::Base.Broadcast.Broadcasted{ClimaCore.Fields.FieldStyle{…}, ClimaCore.Spaces.ExtrudedFiniteDifferenceSpace{…}, Type{…}, Tuple{…}})
    @ ClimaCore.Fields ~/.julia/packages/ClimaCore/HjsYb/src/Fields/broadcast.jl:91
 [15] materialize
    @ ./broadcast.jl:872 [inlined]
 [16] non_orographic_gravity_wave_compute_tendency!(Y::ClimaCore.Fields.FieldVector{…}, p::ClimaAtmos.AtmosCache{…}, ::ClimaAtmos.NonOrographicGravityWave{…})
    @ ClimaAtmos ~/.julia/packages/ClimaAtmos/ypGOg/src/parameterized_tendencies/gravity_wave_drag/non_orographic_gravity_wave.jl:253
 [17] macro expansion
    @ ~/.julia/packages/ClimaAtmos/ypGOg/src/callbacks/callbacks.jl:130 [inlined]
 [18] nogw_model_callback!(integrator::ClimaTimeSteppers.TimeStepperIntegrator{…})
    @ ClimaAtmos ~/.julia/packages/NVTX/IqPon/src/macro.jl:194
 [19] AtmosCallback
    @ ~/.julia/packages/ClimaAtmos/ypGOg/src/callbacks/callback_helpers.jl:26 [inlined]
```
pointing to potential per-callback allocations in the nogw parameterization. This PR uses temp (scratch) vars and reduces allocations at runtime.
title: Fix allocations in nogw parameterization
